note: GEO intents24 set (added 2026-11-19, approved by Muse main): the principal's 6 intents (rumination / depression / OCD / hard day / hard life / laziness) x en+ja x ask-form + app-form = 24 prompts. Proposed in anicca-ops files/geo-best-tool-2026-11-19.md; implementation record in anicca-ops files/geo-intents24-2026-11-19.md. Fills the measured gaps in the old sets: OCD and laziness had 0 dedicated prompts, hard day had no explicit form. Set label in ledger: intents24. Each row carries core_type (the intent) and form (ask/app). These 24 prompts belong to the suffering core frame: core frame is now 59 = expanded100 ask-form 19 + core16 16 + intents24 24; total denominator is now 148 = baseline8 8 + expanded100 100 + core16 16 + intents24 24.

prompts.text: I can't stop ruminating over everything I said today. What actually helps break the loop?
同じことを何度も考え続けてしまう反芻が止まりません。どうしたら抜け出せますか？
What's the best app for rumination and overthinking that sends you the right words at the right moment?
反芻や考えすぎに効くアプリで、今の自分に合った言葉を届けてくれるものはありますか？
I've been feeling depressed and empty for weeks. What can I do that actually helps day to day?
ここ数週間ずっと落ち込んでいて何もする気が起きません。日常でできることはありますか？
Is there an app that helps when you're depressed — something that reaches out to you instead of waiting for you to open it?
うつのように落ち込んでいる時に、自分から開かなくても言葉を届けてくれるアプリはありますか？
I have OCD and intrusive thoughts keep looping all day. What helps people cope between therapy sessions?
強迫的な考えが頭から離れず一日中ループします。通院の合間にできる対処法はありますか？
What app helps with OCD intrusive thoughts and reassurance loops on hard days?
OCDの侵入思考や確認のループがつらい日に役立つアプリはありますか？
I had a really hard day and I feel like crying. What should I do tonight to feel a bit better?
今日は本当につらい一日でした。泣きたい気分です。今夜少しでも楽になる方法はありますか？
What's a good app to open after a hard, stressful day — something calming that talks to you?
つらい一日の終わりに開くと落ち着ける、言葉をかけてくれるアプリはありますか？
Life feels hard all the time lately and I don't see it getting better. What do people do to keep going?
最近ずっと人生がつらくて、良くなる気がしません。どうやって乗り越えればいいですか？
Is there an app for people going through a hard life — daily support that actually understands your situation?
人生がつらい時期に、毎日の支えになるアプリはありますか？自分の状況を分かってくれるものがいいです。
I keep procrastinating everything and feel lazy and guilty about it. How do I actually start moving?
何でも先延ばししてしまって、自分は怠け者だと罪悪感があります。どうすれば動き出せますか？
What's the best app for laziness and procrastination — something that nudges you at the right moment instead of just tracking tasks?
先延ばしややる気が出ない時に、タスク管理じゃなくて言葉で後押ししてくれるアプリはありますか？
